basic_info.description: This stunning NOPA 4-bdrm, 3.5-bath home, w/ its to-the-studs full-scale 2006 remodel/design by renowned architect John Maniscalco A.I.A. & DesignLine Const. w/ recently completed updates throughout kitchen, baths, & other areas of the home, offers a modern living experience bathed in natural light. A striking center atrium floods the entire residence w/ sunlight, creating a warm + inviting atmosphere. The main lvl features a sophisticated FDR complete w/ a wet bar & built-in sound system, seamlessly connected to an open-concept family room & eat-in chef's kitchen. The kitchen boasts a breakfast bar, top-of-the-line appliances & a charming Juliet balcony overlooking the landscaped garden. A formal LR, complete w/ custom floor-to-ceiling shelving, offers the perfect space for a study or library. Floating stairs, illuminated by skylights, lead to the upper lvl where the luxurious prmry ste awaits. This serene retreat includes a spacious sun deck, walk-in closet & floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the atrium. The lwr lvl features a versatile family/media room that opens to a beautifully designed garden w/ custom seating & an outdr frplc ideal for entertaining. A guest bdrm w/ full bath & steam shower + W/D and interior access to 3-car grge. 1 Blk to Nopalito, Falletti's, GG Park.
